analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI remains in the neutral zone at 48.3 today. ADX is at 10.2, indicating no established trend. With a stop loss of 1.3x ATR (5,923 KRW) against the current ATR of 4,556 KRW, a 10.2% rise to the target price of 117,523 KRW (1.5 R/R) is required. The current resistance at 111,355 KRW is only 4.46% above the current price of 106,600 KRW. Weak basis for a buy entry.
